verdict.rationale: Bento's own docs describe a span tree built from OpenTelemetry spans and capture of every model call, tool call, and agent step. Runs can be grouped via a `session_id` applied to every span and a `convo_id` that ties runs together, which covers both the nested-span and the session/thread parts of the story. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how span parent/child nesting is structured and how sessions or threads are viewed, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads

citations.quote: Every span from every framework, captured over OpenTelemetry. Open the span tree
Capture every model call, tool call, and agent step from a Google ADK app with one line.
`init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id`, and `tags` kwargs. Bento invokes them on every span
pass the same `convo_id` on every call and Bento ties the runs together for you.
